title: Top 5 Most POWERFUL Explosions In The Universe
hook: Number one unleashed more energy in a few seconds than our Sun will radiate across its entire 10-billion-year lifetime — the brightest explosion ever recorded.

items.name: Nova Explosion
items.stat: A white dwarf steals gas from a companion star, igniting a thermonuclear blast that brightens it up to 100,000 times in days.

items.name: Kilonova
items.stat: Two neutron stars collide and forge gold and platinum, releasing 1,000 times the energy of a normal nova.
items.query: kilonova neutron star merger artist concept

items.name: Supernova (SN 1994D)
items.stat: A dying star's explosion can briefly outshine its entire host galaxy of billions of stars.

items.name: Hypernova / Eta Carinae
items.stat: This unstable star is 100 times the Sun's mass and could detonate with 10 times a normal supernova's power.

items.name: Gamma-Ray Burst (GRB 080319B)
items.stat: In seconds it emits more energy than the Sun will in 10 billion years — the brightest explosion ever recorded.
